name: Lucidchart AI
tagline: Lucidchart is a diagramming tool used to create flowcharts, org charts, network diagrams, and UML diagrams. Its AI features include AI-generated diagrams from text descriptions, automatic layout optimisation, and an AI assistant that answers questions about diagram content. Teams use it to document processes and systems visually.
